hypothesis: Sparse per-view cache occupancy may justify fewer fixed column slots while preserving exact-key fallback. Qualify full regions, not requested-byte counts.
decision: Reject both prototypes and restore all runtime/test changes. Keep 32x32 column slots and 32x32 masks. Compound variant broke existing mask coverage; isolated variant failed the Metal performance screen.

notes: Counts are per measured region, including exact fallback map entries. Requested slot payload is cumulative, not peak RSS or total allocator traffic.
The compound constant also controlled material-mask capacity through super imports; it reduced mask capacity 4x and introduced scalar fallbacks.

The isolated variant preserves the original mask geometry. Its smaller column cache moves hundreds of thousands of entries into the existing fallback map and does not reduce reconstructed-prefix counts.
Neither instrumented wall time nor the 75% requested-slot-byte reduction establishes end-to-end improvement.

compound_later_existing_mask_coverage_te.meaning: Expected complete 32x32 mask window returned scalar-fallback None at collisions; generated NBT still matched, but the established cache-coverage invariant was broken. This failure is retained, not bypassed or reclassified as passing.

validation.normal_release_builds: Both actual prototypes built successfully; source frozen and binary copied before generation. No owned builds overlapped headline timings.

process_cpu.clock_scope: Unix timestamps bracket the batch and CPU samples for observation alignment only; wall-clock adjustments may affect them. Latency uses the existing monotonic perf_counter interval. No per-request CPU attribution is implied.
process_cpu.scope: Process user/kernel deltas for the whole process and all its threads around the measured batch, including executor creation/join and host driver work. Excludes startup, warmups, readiness wait and later snapshot/hash/NBT validation work. GPU device execution and other processes are not CPU time here. Context-switch/fault counts are platform-reported observations, not wait durations. Average scheduled cores is CPU seconds divided by elapsed batch seconds, not worker occupancy or an elapsed-time share.

screening_scope: Four interleaved ABBA fresh processes per variant/backend, two measured regions and one warmup per process. These are two-pair screens, not five-pair acceptance qualification. Losing/inconclusive candidates are rejected before spending the broader acceptance matrix.
coordinates_note: All cycle9 runs use harness defaults: regions (-1,-1) and (0,-1), seed 123456789. Baseline and candidate are matched. These are not the cycle8(0,0) workload, and timings or occupancy are not compared across those windows.
host_and_readiness: Scoped activity/taskpolicy context is equal within each ABBA series; power/thermal/process observations retained in each external screen folder. Other workloads were not stopped, power settings unchanged, and CPU timing variance was substantial. Actual CPU/Metal selections recorded after generation.
opportunities_remaining: Lazy spatial pages could preserve direct-slot coverage while reducing sparse initialization, but the older unmerged prototype is not a proven win; extra indirection/allocation needs its own experiment.
91.99% prefix identity in cycle8 remains a lead, not a correctness certificate for skipping reconstruction.
Continue independent O5/O6/O9 work; actual Windows transport qualification still pending.
release: No release or distribution JAR build.
